clips.title: The story
paras: In Southshore, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle seeks a way back to Stormwind. He has compiled an exaggerated report of his deeds against the coastal naga and sends an adventurer to Stormwind Keep to deliver it to his former mentor, Major Samuelson.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle resents his posting in the Hillsbrad Foothills. In Southshore, far from the capital and under Marshal Redpath's stern watch, he spends his days plotting a transfer south. He takes credit for clearing out the nearby Daggerspine naga to make himself look like an indispensable, battle-hardened officer ready for promotion.

Farren wants a transfer without drawing Marshal Redpath's suspicion, so he goes around the local chain of command. He turns to Major Samuelson, a senior officer in Stormwind Keep who mentored him in the past. A report delivered straight to Samuelson puts Farren's claimed deeds before someone with authority over garrison assignments.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It shouldn't be a problem getting my report seen. The new captain of the guard, Major Samuelson, was my mentor while I was stationed in Stormwind. It should give him more than enough excuse to have me transferred back to the city. I'll need you to carry my report to him, though... Wouldn't want ol' Redpath to catch on.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, citizen. May the Stormwind city guard be of assistance?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What's this? Ah... So my attentive pupil has applied himself to the problem of the naga in Southshore. Thank you for bringing this to me, I will certainly take it into account when I review personnel assignments in the next month.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
